notes: This registry is intentionally strict about classifying internal heuristics versus externally anchored metrics.
A metric can be sourced from a trusted methodology owner and still remain partial_proxy if the issuer disclosures are incomplete.
If a feature has no credible single external methodology owner, it is labeled internal_derived or internal_heuristic rather than being over-claimed as market-native.

definition_requirement_legend.must_have_external_definition: First-order market-underwritten metric. If Axiom uses this in consumer/industrials, the definition should come from a trusted external methodology, official filing regime, or standardized market-data owner.
definition_requirement_legend.can_be_externally_anchored: Useful market-context transform whose raw ingredients should be external, but the exact roll-up, banding, or window is not dictated by one universal external owner.
definition_requirement_legend.must_remain_internal_inference: Decision-support abstraction, data-quality control, or latent-intent/regime proxy with no single trusted external definition. Keep it internal and label it as inference.

methodology_execution_legend.adopt_exact_external_methodology: Use a named trusted external methodology, official filing regime, or provider-standardized definition as the metric definition itself.
methodology_execution_legend.keep_externally_anchored_house_formula: Use trusted external raw inputs, but keep a documented deterministic Axiom transform because no single external owner cleanly defines the final metric.
methodology_execution_legend.retain_internal_inference: Keep the metric as an internal inference, control, or strategy feature because no single trusted external definition exists.
